state.project: Miu World: a 3D voxel learn-while-playing online game for all ages (children and adults), web now and a mobile app later. Built 100% by AI. Today only the owner and one child play; no outside players yet.
state.owner_requirement: Game for every age, online like Minecraft; it does not require parental supervision; parents who let a child play are responsible. Never gate a new feature behind parent approval; parent controls are optional conveniences.
state.account_model: One Google account = one primary player (the person who signs in); up to two extra players on a shared device (e.g. the owner's child). The account area has an optional PIN. No free-text names (chosen from a list), no free chat.
state.old_plan: Parent area & friends plan (approved 2026-10-04, before the new direction): parent sees learning progress; parent switches online and companion bots per child profile; friends by a 6-character code where BOTH parents must approve; parent sees block/report log; consent update.
facts: Moderation and abuse reporting are parked until people outside the family play.
Friend codes are shared privately (no public player search); a code exchange already requires knowing each other.
Companion bots are currently switched on/off in a local browser setting; online rooms exist on the hub.
The skill progress data (skills, levels, quests done) already exists on the server per player.

friend_approval.instructions: How should two players become friends under the new all-ages model?

criteria.players_accept: Each player accepts the other's code request themselves; no parent approval. The account owner can see and remove friends of the extra players on the account.
criteria.extra_players_need_owner: Primary players accept themselves; a request involving an extra player also needs that account owner's approval.
criteria.both_parents_approve: Keep the old rule: both account owners approve every friendship.

online_switch.instructions: Who controls going online and the companion bots?

criteria.player_setting: Each player's own setting in Settings (stored on the server per player); the account owner may switch them for extra players from the account area.
criteria.account_area_only: Only the account owner switches them, from the account area.

progress_view.instructions: Where is the learning progress (skills strong/weak, suggested next quests, weekly play time) shown?

criteria.player_and_owner: Each player sees their own progress in their Profile; the account owner also sees every player of the account in the account area.

friends_default.instructions: Before moderation exists, should friends by code be available by default?

criteria.on_by_code: On by default: friends only through privately shared codes, no public search, no chat; revisit moderation before any public discovery.
criteria.off_until_moderation: Off by default in production until moderation is built.
